P.C. :
1) Applicants, accused in Cc No. 2087/Pw/2021 pending on the file of learned
Metropolitan Magistrate, 48 th Court, Andheri, Mumbai, arising out of C.R. No. 48 of
2021 dated 2 nd February 2021, registered with Oshiwara Police Station, District
Mumbai, under Sections 420, 406, 504, 506(2) read with 34 of I.P.C. have filed
present Application under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. for quashing of the said case with
the consent of Respondent No.2, the informant.

Learned Advocate for Applicants submitted that, the Applicants and Respondent No.2 have settled their disputes and differences amicably and the Applicants have agreed to pay certain amount to the Respondent No.2 in installments.
That, the 'Supplementary Terms of Compromise to Consent Terms Agreement dated 24 th November 2021' is accordingly executed on 27th July 2024.
He therefore submitted that, the said case may be quashed with the consent of Respondent No.2.
3) Learned Advocate for Respondent No.2 submitted that, the Respondent No.2 has filed an Affidavit in support of settlement dated 13 th August 2024, duly affirmed before a Notary Public.
To the said Affidavit, the Supplementary Terms of Compromise dated 27 th July 2024 to Consent Terms Agreement dated 24th November 2021 is annexed.
In para No. 4 thereof, the Respondent No.2 has admitted the fact of Consent Terms Agreement dated 24th November 2021 and Supplementary Terms of Compromise dated 27 th July 2024.
In para No. 6 thereof, the Respondent No.2 has given his no objection for quashing of the said crime.

3.1) Though the Respondent No.2 is not personally present in the Court, Advocate Mr. Nainesh N.
Amin appearing for him, on instructions, submitted that, the Respondent No.2 admits the contents of his Affidavit dated 13th August 2024 and gives his 'no objection' for quashing of the crime in question.

4) In view thereof, we are inclined to quash CC No. 2087/PW/2021 pending on the file of learned Metropolitan Magistrate, 48 th Court, Andheri, Mumbai, arising out of C.R. No. 48 of 2021 dated 2 nd February 2021, registered with Oshiwara Police Station, District Mumbai,
5) As we expressed our opinion for quashing of CC No. 2087/PW/2021 pending on the file of learned Metropolitan Magistrate, 48 th Court, Andheri, Mumbai, learned Advocate for Applicants on instructions submitted that, the Applicants will pay a cost of Rs.50,000/- each, totalling to Rs.2,00,000/-, jointly or severally, to the Armed Forces Battle Casualties Welfare Fund within a period of two weeks from the date of uploading of present Order on the official website of High Court of Bombay.

6) We therefore direct the Applicants to pay a cost of Rs.2,00,000/- and the Respondent No.2 to pay a cost of Rs.1,00,000/- to the Armed Forces Battle Casualties Welfare Fund within a period of two weeks from the date of Osk 14-Apl-1128-2021.doc uploading of present Order on the official website of High Court of Bombay.

Account Name :- Armed Forces Battle Casualties Welfare Fund.
 Account Number :- 90552010165915.
 Bank Name :- Canara Bank.
 Branch :- South Block, Defence Headq  New Delhi - 110 011.

 6.2) Applicants and Respondent No.2 to deposit the said co stipulated period as noted above and submit receipt(s) of the same in the Registry of this Court.
7) In view of the above and subject to payment of cost by both Applicants and Respondent No.2, Application is allowed in terms of prayer clause (a).
8) It is made clear that, if the cost is not paid within stipulated period as mentioned above, the Application shall stand revived automatically and in that event, the trial Court will proceed with the said case expeditiously.
